name: kortexa-editorial
summary: Cinematic 'worksheet' carousel on black: full-bleed dark, moody photos (real listing or founder photos, graded down with film grain and vignette; a lime-tinted dark backdrop when there is no photo). Each question slide layers a heavy white uppercase Montserrat question over a giant lime italic serif numeral ('1.'), then fill-in prompts in italic serif with long white underline rules. One word is circled with a hand-drawn lime scribble. Cover: huge lime uppercase headline with white words and one white italic serif word. Ends on one lime CTA button.

archetypes.name: cover
archetypes.description: Cover, centred. Huge lime uppercase headline of 6-10 words. Wrap 1-3 words in **double stars** to turn them white, and ONE short word or number in *single stars* to set it in white italic serif (e.g. 'HOW TO GET YOUR *next* LISTING **NOTICED.**'). Body = one casual italic subline at the bottom (max 10 words). Optional kicker = tiny italic serif line above. Optional photo via image_path (append '#pos=50% 0%' to move the crop).

archetypes.name: question
archetypes.description: Worksheet slide. Heading = a short question in uppercase (4-8 words, ends with '?'), drawn in white over a giant lime italic serif numeral. The numeral is the question's number: set kicker to '1', '2'... (or leave it empty to count question slides). Bullets = 1-4 fill-in prompts in the reader's voice; a bullet ending with ':' gets a long underline to write on (e.g. 'My hero shot:', 'Price shown? (yes/no):'); a bullet without ':' is an italic line; a bullet of only '___' adds a blank writing line. Circle ONE word on the slide with ~~tildes~~ (e.g. 'The ~~one~~ keyword I'll use:'). Optional body = one short italic line above the prompts. Photo via image_path; '#right' puts the whole photo on the right with the text column on the left.

archetypes.name: takeaway
archetypes.description: The lesson in one line. Kicker = a short italic serif lead-in in lime (e.g. 'Remember this:'). Heading = uppercase statement of 4-8 words with one **lime** word or one ~~circled~~ word. Body = one or two short italic sentences (max 18 words).

archetypes.name: cta
archetypes.description: Closing slide with the full Kortexa logo. Optional kicker = italic lead-in (e.g. 'Want my checklist?'). Uppercase heading of 3-6 words with one **lime** word. Body is exactly the call to action ('Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook'), rendered as a lime button with black text.

decorations: accent serif italic 'Instrument Serif' for the big numerals, worksheet prompts, the cover's italic word and the @handle
cinematic photo treatment: dark, desaturated backgrounds, film grain and vignette; lime-tinted dark glow when no photo
giant lime italic serif numeral with a period layered behind the uppercase question
long thin white underline rules to fill in after each prompt
hand-drawn lime scribble ellipse circling one word
small italic @handle bottom left, 'save for later' bookmark cue bottom centre, 'swipe' arrow bottom right
Kortexa lockup top left on the cover, small Kortexa mark top right on inner slides, full logo on the CTA
lime CTA button with black text
hook_patterns: Plan + do it: 'HOW TO PLAN YOUR *next* LISTING AND ACTUALLY **SELL IT.**'
tone: First person 'I' (the founder) talking straight to 'you', the agent, like a friend handing over a worksheet. Simple eighth-grade English, short questions, casual italic asides. Confident and helpful, never hype. No made-up numbers, no prices, no guarantees.
caption_style: Five-line formula: 1) hook line restating slide 1 in new words; 2) 2-4 short lines telling them to screenshot and fill it in; 3) a question to spark comments; 4) 'Comment LISTING and I'll send you the playbook.'; 5) 3-5 hashtags such as #realestatemarketing #realestateagent #listingtips. No emojis or at most one. No prices.
